Bike JC Light-Up Ride

Jersey City, NJ · Downtown · Social

Beginner friendlyFamily

Bike JC Light-Up Ride is a social group ride in Jersey City, NJ. It rolls monthly, on a Friday at 7:30 pm from Grove Street PATH plaza. Pace: slow, social. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bikejcgram the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike JC Light-Up Ride group ride

A monthly evening group ride from the Grove Street PATH plaza, run by Jersey City's bike advocacy group. Lights on, easy pace, all kinds of bikes. The next date is posted on bikejc.org and Instagram.
